Quick answers

The help pages cover downloads, guest purchases, payments, refunds and accounts.

The guides go step by step through buying, Your Stacc and refunds, and the creator manual covers the Studio, selling, packs and payouts.

Write to AutoStacc

Email support@autostacc.com.

For anything about an order, include its number (on your receipt and in Settings › Orders). Never send your password.

Things you can do yourself

  • Download your purchases again: Your Stacc.
  • Forgot your password: reset it.
  • Change your name, password or emails, download your data or delete your account: Settings.

Artists and projects

To reach an artist, use the links on their project's page. To publish your own work, start a free creator space in the Studio.
